ideas.name: Target-Date Fund Rebalancing Pressure
ideas.claim: Stocks with greater indirect target-date fund ownership have lower returns during and following high stock-market returns.
ideas.quote: Looking across all stocks while controlling for characteristics, greater TDF ownership is associated with lower individual stock returns in the same month as high stock market returns and in the following month.
ideas.mechanism: FLOW: target-date funds rebalance between stocks and bonds, creating contrarian flows in their underlying equity holdings.

rules.timeframe: Monthly observations; same month and following month
rules.filters: Greater indirect target-date fund ownership; high stock-market returns. Trading thresholds are not stated.

ideas.claimed_result: Greater target-date fund ownership is associated with lower individual stock returns in the same month as high stock-market returns and in the following month.
